title: 조회자 목록 맨 위의 이름
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie rock with elements of post-punk and dream pop. The track features a prominent, driving electric bass line playing eighth notes with a slightly overdriven tone. Clean electric guitars utilize chorus and delay effects, alternating between rhythmic palm-muted staccato patterns and sustained, atmospheric arpeggios. Drums maintain a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hats. Male vocals are delivered in a melodic, slightly breathy baritone register, transitioning into a more powerful, soaring chest voice during the chorus. The production uses moderate hall reverb on the vocals and guitars to create a sense of space. Key of E minor, 120 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[driving overdriven bass line, steady drum beat, clean electric guitar staccato riff]

[Verse 1]
[melodic baritone male vocals]
걸어왔다 건물 옥상에 올라갔다
바람이 차다 난간이 차갑다
장갑 없이 올라왔다 손이 빨갛다
멀리 공장 지대가 보인다
굴뚝이 다섯 개다
연기가 올라가고 있다 느리게 멈추지 않고

[Chorus]
[vocals transition to soaring chest voice, guitars switch to sustained arpeggios with heavy reverb]
눈을 떴다 구름에 있다
연기가 올라가서 구름에 닿는다
어디까지가 연기고
어디부터가 구름인지
경계가 없다
